source: Source: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, Population Censuses of 1998, 2017 (provisional results) and 2023, as published in the PakPC2017 and PakPC2023 R packages; district boundaries from geoBoundaries. Growth is the average yearly rate between censuses. Districts created since 1998 are counted with the district they came from, so that each one covers the same area in every census; former FATA is part of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa throughout. Gilgit-Baltistan and Azad Kashmir are not in these censuses.
